name: Tens
source:
A Nox sub-boss in the Nox syndicate. 

Tens spent most of his early life as an infamously savage and unpredictable criminal, fueled by chems and a lust for violence. Tens is and was widely feared throughout Neo Elysia. 

However, after a mysterious and tragic circumstance left him disfigured and near death, Tens claims to have turned a new leaf and left that part of him behind. 

Only time will tell if that turns out to be true...
